limits: Six original T38.04/.05 criterion/V1 pairs; author implementation and finite executed evidence, not learner mastery.
Actual unchanged PiI2c/PiRecovery/PuRates producers and F439 mapped adapter; MPS2 executes C/Thumb with RAM register models, not an I2C peripheral emulator.
Synthetic analog evidence packets and bounded rational model; physical board routes, instrument accuracy, rise/fall/hold waveforms remain required.
No arbitrary-length transaction, interrupt latency, multi-controller recovery lease implementation or full T38 closure.
